name: Charon
legendaryAbilityText: After you move 1 of your ships out of Charon's system and into a non-home system, you may move the Charon token with it. During space combat, if this planet is not exhausted, it may particpate as if it were a ship. When you would assign a hit to this planet, exhaust it instead.
flavourText: *A shattered world of extreme thermal violence, floating through the dark like a jagged, burning eye.*
